correctness.rationale: The frozen RESULT.md transfer-matrix entries in the positive-symbol transitions read literal \nu rather than u (three cells), so the printed formal polynomial is wrong. The full replacement RESULT.md repairs that mathematical formula, supplies every corrected transition and repeats complete theorem/proof/scope. Independently, the polar is |f_a-f_b|<=1. A polar vertex iff its tight-edge graph is connected, forcing hub-relative ternary potentials; adjacency excludes opposite signs and each zero must be neighbor-supported. The corrected four-state transfer counts all such words. Centering produces norm²=p+q-(p-q)²/(m+1). At least two zeros => norm²<=m-2; with one zero balanced opposite-sign blocks maximize at m-1-epsilon/(m+1); one-sign words attain at most (m+1)/4, strictly lower for m>=3. Antipodal support constraints bound all possible inball centers, and contact-normal rank one/two yields the full center-set affine dimensions. Exact independent 6846-word rational checks for m2..10 agree; finite checks are corroborative only.
residual_risks: Reproducible finite checks and existing verification logs never prove unbounded theorems; the above analytic argument supplies the proof.
